schedule_rng.scope: six configurations independently permuted within each parent/patch/seed block; generation RNG separate

numeric.Euler50: Production k/50 t; constant Python1/50; FP32 state + FP32 velocity * dt
numeric.Midpoint25: Historical Python FP64 ideal k/25 grid; dt=t1-t0; midpoint=(t0+t1)*.5; independent FP32 casts; update from original state
numeric.E_quad50: Historical Python FP64 (k/50)^2 grid; dt=t1-t0 before FP32 cast; front dense back sparse
numeric.runtime: CUBLAS :4096:8; deterministic warn_only=False; TF32 off; SDPA math; BF16 forwards, FP32 params/states/integration; eval/no_grad

dispatch.CPU_workers: chosen from current available CPU/RAM and load before dispatch
dispatch.initial_GPU_peak: Observe authorized regression group; no probe forward; process VRAM plus allocated/reserved independently

statistics.macro: mean two seeds per parent/patch then equal ten units
statistics.missing: Difference requires all operands finite; cell mean requires both seeds; full macro requires all requested cells. Incomplete observed summaries separately labeled with valid/requested counts; never zero fill.
statistics.sign: lower errors/counts better, higher coverage better, area descriptive only
statistics.success: No weighted score or new numerical success threshold; primary candidate interpretation based on all fixed metrics and strata

binding.numerical_rule: inherit original cross_binding, raw differences retained

plots.bbox: each parent original GT bounding cube center; radius=.60*max_axis_span

failure_contract: No automatic retries, extra seeds, replacement outputs or unregistered forward calls. Stop dispatch after numerical/OOM/identity/regression failure; preserve attempted NFE and all120 requested rows.
baseline_inheritance: Inherited BF16 face-permutation FAIL remains FAIL at its original tolerance; not retested or repaired.
topology: Existing metrics retained; global watertight/exact-predicate certification NOT_RUN
